<?xml version='1.0'?>
<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM 'fonts.dtd'>
<fontconfig>
	<!-- CS2 Font Studio. Delete this file to remove all changes. -->
	<!-- state: {"rules":[{"group":"Stratum2 Mono","font":"Impact","scale":0.9},{"group":"Stratum2 Condensed","font":"","scale":1.2}],"copied":["notosans-impact.ttf"]} -->
	<match target="font"><test name="family"><string>Stratum2 Mono</string></test><edit name="family" mode="assign"><string>Impact</string></edit></match>
	<match target="pattern"><test name="family"><string>Stratum2 Mono</string></test><edit name="family" mode="prepend" binding="strong"><string>Impact</string></edit></match>
	<match target="font"><test name="family" target="pattern"><string>Stratum2 Mono</string></test><edit name="pixelsize" mode="assign"><times><name>pixelsize</name><double>0.9</double></times></edit></match>
	<match target="font"><test name="family" target="pattern"><string>Stratum2 Condensed</string></test><edit name="pixelsize" mode="assign"><times><name>pixelsize</name><double>1.2</double></times></edit></match>
</fontconfig>

<?xml version='1.0'?>
<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM 'fonts.dtd'>
<fontconfig>
	<!-- CS2 Font Studio. Delete this file to remove all changes. -->
	<!-- state: {"rules":[{"group":"Stratum2 Mono","font":"Impact","scale":1,"weight":700,"italic":true,"width":0.8},{"group":"Stratum2","font":"","scale":1,"weight":300}],"copied":null} -->
	<match target="font"><test name="family"><string>Stratum2 Mono</string></test><edit name="family" mode="assign"><string>Impact</string></edit></match>
	<match target="pattern"><test name="family"><string>Stratum2 Mono</string></test><edit name="family" mode="prepend" binding="strong"><string>Impact</string></edit></match>
	<match target="pattern"><test name="family"><string>Stratum2 Mono</string></test><edit name="weight" mode="assign" binding="strong"><int>200</int></edit><edit name="slant" mode="assign" binding="strong"><const>italic</const></edit></match>
	<match target="font"><test name="family" target="pattern"><string>Stratum2 Mono</string></test><edit name="matrix" mode="assign"><times><name>matrix</name><matrix><double>0.8</double><double>0.2</double><double>0</double><double>1</double></matrix></times></edit></match>
	<match target="pattern"><test name="family"><string>Stratum2</string></test><edit name="weight" mode="assign" binding="strong"><int>50</int></edit></match>
</fontconfig>

<?xml version='1.0'?>
<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM 'fonts.dtd'>
<fontconfig>
	<!-- CS2 Font Studio. Delete this file to remove all changes. -->
	<!-- state: {"rules":[{"group":"Stratum2","font":"Arial","scale":1.15,"italic":true},{"group":"A\u0026B \u003c\"x'\u003e","font":"Roboto","scale":1,"width":1.25}],"copied":null,"textScale":1.25} -->
	<match target="font"><edit name="pixelsize" mode="assign"><times><name>pixelsize</name><double>1.25</double></times></edit></match>
	<match target="font"><test name="family"><string>Stratum2</string></test><edit name="family" mode="assign"><string>Arial</string></edit></match>
	<match target="pattern"><test name="family"><string>Stratum2</string></test><edit name="family" mode="prepend" binding="strong"><string>Arial</string></edit></match>
	<match target="font"><test name="family" target="pattern"><string>Stratum2</string></test><edit name="pixelsize" mode="assign"><times><name>pixelsize</name><double>1.15</double></times></edit></match>
	<match target="pattern"><test name="family"><string>Stratum2</string></test><edit name="slant" mode="assign" binding="strong"><const>italic</const></edit></match>
	<match target="font"><test name="family"><string>A&B <"x'></string></test><edit name="family" mode="assign"><string>Roboto</string></edit></match>
	<match target="pattern"><test name="family"><string>A&B <"x'></string></test><edit name="family" mode="prepend" binding="strong"><string>Roboto</string></edit></match>
	<match target="font"><test name="family" target="pattern"><string>A&B <"x'></string></test><edit name="matrix" mode="assign"><times><name>matrix</name><matrix><double>1.25</double><double>0</double><double>0</double><double>1</double></matrix></times></edit></match>
</fontconfig>
